details: Single-active-theme replacement: clean Ruby White premium mobile HTML (one CSS file), seven independent optimized realistic sushi/chef/ingredient WebP visuals from the approved blend of concepts #1+#3, one Ruby White workspace theme replacing Ocean 3.2 workspace CSS. Five tabs, existing TTK/Projects/PDF editor routes, true cloud auth and update checker retained. Seven catalog/history areas remain marked as upcoming. This is a WEB interface release; no signed Android APK changes, no claim of native 8K raster fidelity or real-device pixel-perfect tests.
